question: Where and with which mantra should Tripurā be worshipped?
premises: The worship uses a nine-syllable mantra.
Tripurā is the deity to be worshipped.
The location is the sixty-four-petaled lotus.
inference: One should worship Tripurā on the sixty-four-petaled lotus with the nine-syllable mantra.
plain_english: One should worship Tripurā on the sixty-four-petaled lotus with the nine-syllable mantra.
